name: Overwritten Save
source:
Maki and Maguro were isekai'd to a world where various cuisine-themed creatures known as Ramemon exist. Initially very excited about this new life, they both set out on their new adventure alongside their Ramemon.

Though, Maki realizes that things aren't so fun when you aren't the hero character.

[From [url=https://keropro.itch.io/overwritten-save]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
真希和金枪鱼来到了一个异世界，那里存在着各种以美食为主题的生物，称为“拉蒙”。最初对这个新生活感到非常兴奋，他们俩和他们的拉蒙一起开始了新的冒险。

不过，真希意识到，当你不是英雄角色时，事情就不那么有趣了。

[来自[url=https://keropro.itch.io/overwritten-save]itch.io[/url]]
